decisions.reason: As a newly launched core screening machine with its own page and even an early positive market signal, management is likely to justify the recent investment and keep it on the market.
This multi-model mobile shredder line represents a visible and substantial commitment in one of the firm's core application areas, so disappointing early uptake would likely be treated as temporary.
Although website visibility is weaker, it is still a new product line in the firm's central mobile processing business, which makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.

The stationary electric fine shredder appears less visibly promoted than some others, but its fit with resource-saving recycling solutions and the tendency to defend recent development spending support retention.
This green-waste grinder line is close to the firm's established mobile equipment portfolio, so management would likely continue backing it while attributing any weak early results to market ramp-up.
A dedicated page and a whole line of stationary pre-shredders signal high public commitment and investment, making continuation the more likely choice.
